# observe_default_dashboard_for_tag

Manages the default dashboard for a correlation tag. This dashboard is
displayed in the UI when pivoting on the tag.

The binding is customer-wide and keyed by correlation tag name. There is
one default dashboard per tag name.
## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "observe_dashboard" "example" {
  name = "Example Dashboard"
}

resource "observe_default_dashboard_for_tag" "example" {
  tag       = "k8s.namespace.name"
  dashboard = observe_dashboard.example.oid
}
```
<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dashboard` (String) The OID of the default dashboard for the tag.
- `tag` (String) The correlation tag name whose default dashboard is being managed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
# Use the correlation tag name to import the default dashboard binding
terraform import observe_default_dashboard_for_tag.example k8s.namespace.name
```
